setup_command: export UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=300 UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/clawgap-uv-cache; uv sync --frozen --project backend && uv sync --frozen --project executor && uv sync --frozen --project executor_manager && mkdir -p "$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/data" "$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/socket" && docker run --rm -d --name "clawgap-poco-pg-${CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT##*/}" --network none -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=clawgap -e POSTGRES_DB=poco -v "$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/data:/var/lib/postgresql/data" -v "$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/socket:/var/run/postgresql" postgres:16-alpine@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685 > "$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/container" && for second in $(seq 1 30); do docker exec "$(cat "$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/container")" pg_isready -U postgres -d poco >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done && (cd backend && DATABASE_URL="postgresql+psycopg2://postgres:clawgap@/poco?host=$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/socket" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$PWD/.venv" uv run --project . alembic upgrade head)
launch_command: cleanup() { kill -TERM -- -$backend_pid -$executor_pid -$manager_pid 2>/dev/null || true; docker rm -f "$(cat "$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/container")" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; export DEBUG=false BOOTSTRAP_ON_STARTUP=false DATABASE_URL="postgresql+psycopg2://postgres:clawgap@/poco?host=$CLAWGAP_STATE_ROOT/postgres/socket" AUTH_MODE=disabled SECRET_KEY=clawgap-loopback-mock INTERNAL_API_TOKEN=clawgap-loopback-mock EXECUTOR_MANAGER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18088 RUN_MIGRATIONS=true BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18086 CALLBACK_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18088 CALLBACK_TOKEN=clawgap-loopback-mock ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=clawgap-loopback-mock ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT} DEFAULT_MODEL=clawgap-environment-probe TASK_PULL_ENABLED=false WORKSPACE_ROOT="$HOME/poco-workspaces" S3_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT} S3_ACCESS_KEY=clawgap S3_SECRET_KEY=clawgap-secret S3_BUCKET=clawgap S3_REGION=us-east-1; echo 'Starting Poco backend' >&2; (cd backend && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$PWD/.venv" uv run --project . uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18086) & backend_pid=$!; (cd executor && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$PWD/.venv" uv run --project . uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18087) & executor_pid=$!; (cd executor_manager && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$PWD/.venv" uv run --project . uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18088) & manager_pid=$!; ready=0; for second in $(seq 1 180); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18086/api/v1/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18087/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18088/api/v1/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && ready=1 && echo 'Poco environment ready' && break; sleep 1; done; if [ "$ready" != 1 ]; then exit 1; fi; wait
probe_command: DATABASE_URL='unused' backend/.venv/bin/python -c "import json, os, urllib.request; from anthropic import Anthropic; endpoint='http://127.0.0.1:'+os.environ['CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT']; listing=urllib.request.urlopen(endpoint+'/clawgap?list-type=2', timeout=10); assert b'ListBucketResult' in listing.read(); client=Anthropic(api_key='clawgap-loopback-mock', base_url=endpoint); message=client.messages.create(model='clawgap-environment-probe', max_tokens=32, messages=[{'role':'user','content':'environment probe'}]); assert message.stop_reason == 'end_turn'"
